text: Wings for Life is a non-profit spinal-cord research foundation founded in 2004 by Heinz Kinigadner and Dietrich Mateschitz, based in Salzburg, Austria; Red Bull bears its administrative costs.
short: Wings for Life is a non-profit research foundation in Salzburg, founded in 2004; Red Bull bears its administrative costs.

source.name: Our mission - Wings for Life
source.quote: In 2004 they founded Wings for Life. A non-profit research foundation with the goal of curing spinal cord injury.
source.note: The same page says 'Red Bull bears the administrative costs of the foundation.' and its footer names 'Wings for Life – International Spinal Cord Research Foundation Fürstenallee 4 5020 Salzburg FN 251592p'. The page renders in a browser; the earlier legal-notice URL now redirects to a Terms of Use page for the US foundation.
